title: Search: decoys along the sweep
problem_line: Two objects that look like people lie along the sweep. Only a person decides what is real.

beats.caption: A lawnmower sweep over the sector, camera straight down.
Each candidate is flagged once and grouped with its re-sightings; the decoys too.
The review queue holds the lost person and exactly the two planted decoys, all pending.

success_line: The lost person is found; the two decoys are candidates for review, never confirmations.
